about: [O5b after the critic] the man led (M1, M2 and the cheats): good hands take him in; he steps back out of my face; my car beside me, E get in: he stays in sight and walks to its back door, in only when it stands; at HQ's kerb out and straight in again and away at once: he runs after on my car's way (no catch-up put), 'He's falling behind.' from 40 m, the car stopped: he comes up and gets in, the warning gone; then away for good: warned first, 'He got away.' after 8 s past 70 m.

steps.label: good hands take the man in
M2: he stepped back out of my face

'at the press+0.3 s: inCar '+G.city.inCar+' man visible '+__M().c.object.visible+' inCar '+__M().inCar

(()=>{const s=__hq(),d=s.door;const q=new N.THREE.Vector3(d.x+d.nx*5.5,0,d.z+d.nz*5.5);G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(q.x,q.z);G.city.car.place(q,Math.atan2(-d.nz,d.nx)+Math.PI/2);G.stage.part('bounds').navAround(q.x,q.z,30);return 'car at HQ along the kerb (a tool move: the drive across the city is not the contest)'})()
